claim: In the matching retail DLL, Referee.CheckStandByWrestler (0x060050A8) is a parameterless instance Boolean method with an exact 103-byte body and exactly one direct DLL caller. It loads GlobalWork.inst.MatchSetting and returns false unless MatchSetting.BattleRoyalKind equals raw 4. When the raw value is 4 it scans player indices 0 through 7. For each index it resolves PlayerMan.inst.GetPlObj(index), skips when the object converts false, skips when Player.isSleep is nonzero, and then tests Player.royalRambleAppearTime against raw -1. It returns true immediately when royalRambleAppearTime is not -1; otherwise it continues scanning. After index 7 it returns false. FACT-0091 pins the sole direct caller at Referee.CheckMatchEnd IL+0x0007.
